svg.text: Approximate first and last appearance dates in the fossil record. Solid bars mark well-dated occurrences; pale extensions mark
disputed or poorly constrained dates; diamonds mark taxa known from a single site or specimen.
Detail: the last one million years
Same data, horizontal scale expanded 7.5×. All of this is squeezed into the last 13% of the chart above.
South African cave infills are notoriously hard to date. Sterkfontein Member 4 is conventionally placed at roughly 2.6-2.1 Ma; cosmogenic burial dates of about 3.7-3.4
Ma (Granger et al. 2015, 2022) remain contested. The pale bar shows that disputed older extension.
The Liang Bua skeletons date to about 100-60 ka, not 700 ka. The 700 ka Mata Menge fossils are a related small-bodied population on Flores, shown here as a separate
occurrence rather than as H. floresiensis itself.
Used here in place of H. heidelbergensis, which many researchers now treat as an unusable wastebasket taxon; see proposals for H. bodoensis and H. rhodesiensis, and
note that the Sima de los Huesos sample at 430 ka is genetically on the Neanderthal lineage.
